title: Wombats Make Cube-Shaped Poop
description: Wombats are the only animals known to produce cube-shaped droppings. Scientists worked out how.

scenes.text: There is an animal in Australia that makes poop shaped like little cubes. It is the wombat.
scenes.subject: wombat

scenes.text: For years, nobody knew how it worked. A round tube making square shapes seemed impossible.
scenes.subject: wombat

scenes.text: Scientists found the answer in the gut. The walls of the wombat's intestine have stiff parts and stretchy parts, which press the waste into flat sides and corners.
scenes.subject: wombat

scenes.text: Wombats leave their droppings on rocks and logs to mark territory. Cubes are less likely to roll away.
scenes.subject: wombat

scenes.text: Nature really does think outside the box. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: wombat
